morphology.pattern_note: 不按马来语音节规则将英语专名强行拆读，也不将其结尾视为马来语词缀；is_root 仅保留输入标记。

senses.zh_definition: Slade：英语姓氏，中文可音译为“斯莱德”，也可构成人名或机构名称的一部分。
senses.en_definition: Slade: an English surname that also occurs within proper names, including institutional names.
senses.ms_definition: Slade ialah nama keluarga dalam bahasa Inggeris yang juga boleh menjadi sebahagian daripada nama orang atau institusi.
senses.nuances: 这是可能的专名解读，不是已确认的马来语普通名词。输入未提供指称对象，不能确定具体人物或机构。以下为示范性专名组合，并非经频率验证的固定搭配。[UCL: Slade School history](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/news/2021/sep/slade-school-fine-art-celebrates-150th-anniversary)

etymology.historical_story: One documented cultural connection is the Slade School of Fine Art at University College London. It opened in 1871 following a bequest from the lawyer and collector Felix Slade. Here, a person's surname became part of an institution's identity. This explains that particular name, without establishing the intended reference of the packet's lowercase token. [UCL: Slade School history](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/news/2021/sep/slade-school-fine-art-celebrates-150th-anniversary)
